+def transform(grid):
+    """Paint 3x3 patches around 2s inside the bounding boxes of 3-shaped regions."""
+    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
+    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
+
+    # Find each 4-connected component of color 3; its box also includes any
+    # embedded 2s replacing cells in the rectangular region.
+    unseen = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3}
+    centers = set()
+    while unseen:
+        seed = unseen.pop()
+        stack = [seed]
+        comp = [seed]
+        while stack:
+            r, c = stack.pop()
+            for p in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
+                if p in unseen:
+                    unseen.remove(p)
+                    stack.append(p)
+                    comp.append(p)
+        r0 = min(r for r, c in comp)
+        r1 = max(r for r, c in comp)
+        c0 = min(c for r, c in comp)
+        c1 = max(c for r, c in comp)
+        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
+            for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
+                if grid[r][c] == 2:
+                    centers.add((r, c))
+
+    for r, c in centers:
+        for rr in range(max(0, r - 1), min(h, r + 2)):
+            for cc in range(max(0, c - 1), min(w, c + 2)):
+                if grid[rr][cc] != 2:
+                    out[rr][cc] = 1
+    return out
